title: Grizzlepaw Ridge
wikitext:
[[Image:Grizzlepaw Ridge.jpg|thumb|Grizzlepaw Ridge]]

[[Grizzlepaw Ridge]] is a mountainous area located south of [[Thelsamar]] and east of [[Stonesplinter Valley]] in the [[dwarven]] territory of [[Loch Modan]]. It is inhabited by a large pack of [[bear]]s, and most notably, the ferocious [[Ol' Sooty]], who occasionally wanders down from his lair to the base of the valley, pouncing upon anyone unfortunate to irritate him.
